hints.title: Track Word Frequencies
hints.text: Store the occurrences of each two-letter word in a frequency map.

hints.title: Pair Symmetric Words
hints.text: For a word with differing letters, pair it with its reverse to contribute four letters to the palindrome per pair.

hints.title: Handle Identical Character Words
hints.text: Words with identical letters can be paired with each other in groups of two. At most one leftover identical-character word can sit in the center.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all concatenations produces exponential permutations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting 2-letter combinations takes O(N) time and at most 26x26 = 676 buckets of O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pair opposite words greedily and utilize the central slot.
